trailhead.label: Località Fazzon – Malga Bassa, by the Lago dei Caprioli, the APT’s start

cautions: A rough, steep mountain path for the upper half of the climb (about 2.2 km).
Stream crossings in the Val Baselga.
Possible grazing cattle on the upper pastures in summer.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.A rough, steep mountain path for the upp: Un sentiero di montagna ripido e accidentato per la metà superiore della salita (circa 2,2 km).
Guadi di torrenti in Val Baselga.
textIt.Possible grazing cattle on the upper pas: Possibile bestiame al pascolo sui pascoli alti in estate.
